name: Kri-Kri Milk Industry S.A.
summary: Kri-Kri Milk Industry S.A. operates in the dairy industry in Greece and internationally. The company offers ice creams, yogurt and dessert, fresh milk, and other products, such as gulten free, and cream cheese. It also sells electricity generated biogas and electricity cogeneration units. It distributes its products to supermarket chains and small points of sale. The company also exports its products to approximately 40 countries internationally. Kri-Kri Milk Industry S.A. was founded in 1954 and is headquartered in Serres, Greece.
